author: cms-sw
body:
On a x86-64-v2 host, scram failed to build for multi-archs [a]. 

The problem is that for v2 edmplugin CondToolsSiPhase2TrackerAuto the dependency library was only build for default (v3) that is why edmPluginRefresh was loading v3 version of libCondFormatsSiPixelObjects.so. The fix makes sure that before running edmPluginRefresh we build both v2 and v3 versions of its dependency libs.

[a]
